channel.title: Food Recall Digest
channel.description: Daily audited US food recall summaries

item.title: Fri, Oct 9, 2026: Two more broccoli seed recalls tied to a Salmonella outbreak, plus a baby gripe water and a preworkout recall
item.description: Eden Brothers and Gardeners Basics broccoli seeds may carry Salmonella. One lot of Babies' Magic Tea gripe water contains undeclared alcohols. RAPTURE preworkout contains DMAA. USDA posted store lists for three older recalls.

item.title: Mon, Oct 5, 2026: Nature’s Own Hawaiian Bread recalled for undeclared milk (AR, LA, NM, OK, TX)
item.description: Nature’s Own Hawaiian Bread (20 oz and 40 oz 2-pack) may contain milk that isn’t on the label. No illnesses reported. No other new recalls; outbreak counts unchanged.

item.title: Sat, Oct 3, 2026: Saint Francis frozen pizzas recalled for undeclared soy (Ohio & Kentucky)
item.description: Four Saint Francis frozen pizza varieties sold at 11 Cincinnati-area shops and cincyfavorites.com don’t list soy on the label. No other new recalls; outbreak counts unchanged.

item.title: Fri, Oct 2, 2026: Frozen organic berries at Walmart & Trader Joe’s recalled for E. coli
item.description: More Great Value and Trader Joe’s frozen berry lots recalled for E. coli; Amazon broccoli sprouting seeds for Salmonella; Stewart’s ice cream for metal. Plus 7 older USDA recalls still open, with store lists.

item.title: Thu, Oct 1, 2026: Walmart frozen fettuccine recalled for Listeria
item.description: Walmart bettergoods Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine recalled (all lots) for Listeria. Alfalfa sprout outbreak grows to 76 sick. 2 more stores named for the guanciale recall.

item.title: Wed, Sep 30, 2026: 3 high-risk recalls you should check for
item.description: 3 high-risk recalls: Graziers raw milk cheese (13 sick), Berlin Seeds alfalfa seed, Niwali tejocote. Plus 53 named stores for a USDA meat recall.
